name: YouTubeTranscriptAPI
description: Hosted YouTubeTranscriptAPI MCP server at https://youtubetranscriptapi.com/mcp. Read the transcript of any public YouTube video (with or without timestamps), search YouTube or within one channel, list a channel's or playlist's videos, check a channel's latest uploads, and resolve a channel handle. Read-only tools. Sign in with OAuth, or send an API key as a Bearer token.
author: YouTubeTranscriptAPI
